# hackbuild-agents

> hackbuild-agents is a set of ESM packages under @hackbuild for simulated animals and the people round them in a browser sim: perception (saliency, odour, hearing, eye renders to an occupancy grid) and drives, choice, cue learning and sleep, each on a Rust core in wasm; a capsule mover with steering and a grid path planner; gameplay cameras that drive a three camera without importing three; a parameter registry for A/B work; views of the brain on the hackbuild-ui class layer; and a lockstep scenario runner for headless Chrome. No package loads a model, asset or weight file; randomness is injected as a seeded function.

Every package is ESM only with types included, installs from npm under @hackbuild, and is MIT. Each llms.md below lists the package's exports with signatures, minimal examples and the mistakes to avoid. Code: https://github.com/hackbuild/hackbuild-agents

## Packages

- [@hackbuild/agents-views](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-agents/docs/agents-views/llms.md): The brain bars, the associations table and the eye card of a simulated animal, as views you mount on any page with the hackbuild-ui look.
- [@hackbuild/cameras](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-agents/docs/cameras/llms.md): Gameplay cameras for a browser sim: follow, group framing, orbit, first person and split views, with shared damping, seeded shake and occlusion pull in.
- [@hackbuild/drives](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-agents/docs/drives/llms.md): Drives, choice with a reason, cue learning, sleep and a memory stream for simulated animals, on a Rust core in wasm.
- [@hackbuild/mover](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-agents/docs/mover/llms.md): A kinematic capsule mover and steering for agents that share space, with a grid path planner over the world colliders.
- [@hackbuild/scenario](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-agents/docs/scenario/llms.md): Run a built browser sim in the system Chrome in whole fixed steps, record or compare its trace against a golden file, and report motion checks with their legal ranges.
- [@hackbuild/senses](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-agents/docs/senses/llms.md): Perception for simulated animals: saliency, looming, an odour plume and scent tracking, hearing error, field of view vision and an occupancy grid from eye depth, on a Rust core in wasm.
- [@hackbuild/tunables](https://hackbuild.github.io/hackbuild-agents/docs/tunables/llms.md): A parameter registry with layer switches, presets and URL hash sharing for A/B work on agent behaviour.
